status: completed relevance and independent occurrence-evidence review

review.requirement_proposition: Design and implement technical controls for agentic components, increased security concerns, and multi-agent interactions to mitigate identified risks.
review.reason_for_change: The 31 May 2026 report concerns two voice instances responding in a shared human conversational environment, directly raising controls for agentic-component interactions. The brief report does not establish full timing, whether coordination controls existed, or whether these independent instances were configured as a coordinated multi-agent deployment. The required design/implementation effectiveness cannot be resolved; simultaneous reported responses alone do not prove absent controls.
